title: Settings
dataHint: PickGak fetches Nexon's official hero stats automatically once a day. Nothing to do.
homeLayoutHint: The screen shown by default during a match
safetyText: PickGak never touches the game client, memory, or network traffic. It only uses public web stats and what you enter.
forgetMapsHint: Clear it when a map is misread, then pick the map again.
forgetMapsConfirm: Forget every learned map text? You will have to pick each map again.
forgetMapsDone: Map learning cleared. Hold TAB and pick the map again.
